architecture_patterns.description: WigAIExtension initializes configuration, JettyManager, and McpServerManager; the Jetty server hosts an MCP servlet backed by controllers that orchestrate Bitwig API facades, so the extension acts as a single JVM service exposing MCP tools over SSE while the Bitwig host maintains the lifecycle
architecture_patterns.justification: WigAIExtension init/exit manages server lifecycle, McpServerManager registers MCP tools, JettyServerManager enforces loopback binding

api_contracts_core.summary: Describes every MCP tool, request shape, response structure, and consistent error envelopes for command, transport, session, track, and device operations.
